zone: Zone B = 0.5-1 DD from the disc margin = 1.0-1.5 DD from the centre
reference: width on the HRF manual segmentation (manual1) with the same profile algorithm; A/V from lwnet data/HRF/manual_av; disc = mean of the two experts (xls)
variants: V1 = model width at the expert crossings (manual A/V, expert disc) -> calibre only; V2 = fully automatic vessels + widths on the program-19 ring, manual A/V; V3 = V2 with lwnet A/V
plans: raw-3 = width at the segmentation threshold -3; loio_thr = iso-logit chosen on the other 14 images (min CRAE+CRVE relative error, V1); loio_lin = linear calibration of w@-3 fitted on the other 14 images' six largest A + V
units: native HRF pixels (3504 x 2336); AVR unitless
